notes.title: Harbinger - Legacy Edition Settings Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! Thank you all so much for your patience and understanding.[/p][p]I'd like to introduce a major update that I'll call the Engineer Update for fun! [/p][p][/p][p]This introduces a MAJOR QoL improvement to Harbinger, a custom built Settings application [/p][p]that allows you to edit the settings previously explained in the manual for Harbinger - Legacy Edition.[/p][p]This will edit all of the Setup.Ini's so your don't have to dig into the game and edit them all one by one to change a setting.[/p][p]Let's take a deeper look into what each Tab introduces! [/p][p]When you first launch the Settings app, "Harbinger INI Editor"[/p][p]The application will do its best to look for your game installation.[/p][p]If it can't find it, it will ask you to locate it for it. Afterwards, you'll be taken to the first tab.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Tab 1 - Game Files[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/02197327a6c56d48135c72bdc964adcc0d4f418b.png"][/img][/p][p]In this tab, you'll see the INI Locator report, it will tell you all of the Setup.Ini's it located in your HARBINGER - Legacy Edition Installation. [/p][p](Please note, the settings do not necessarily apply for Multiplayer, so those are ignored.)[/p][p]There's also an odd chance that if you installed the game previously, but reinstalled it to another drive, the app could detect loose files, and therefore display all of the INI's as missing. If you know where you installed it, you can always use the "CHANGE GAME DIRECTORY" button to manually search for the game installation.[/p][p]The next option is Produce Log Files, this saves automatically, and tells Harbinger to produce log files. This helps significantly if you're contacting me for support![/p][p]Let's look at the next tab...[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Tab 2 - Visuals[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/2ca504c8c5fffa3603b40ecbaf22a42f6ad6af33.png"][/img][/p][p]While I won't run through every individual option here, the visuals tab shows you the available Visual/Optimization options for HARBINGER - Legacy Edition. Most notably "Force Aspect Ratio" For some reason, some people on widescreen or curved monitors can experience crashes if they have this enabled, so turning it off helps drastically.[/p][p]Note that if you're confused about what a certain option does, or what the default for it was, you can hover your mouse over the option to receive a tooltip.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's take a look at the next tab!
[/p][h1]
[b]Tab 3 - Controls[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/3e43eec27943224da3e06585c96e929d56fae57b.png"][/img][/h1][p]In this tab, you can see the honestly needlessly in-depth control mapping the engine uses. You can change your mouse sensitivity, invert it, and change your desired controls with the keystate map here to help. [/p][p]There's also a fun option to disable the ability to lean around cover if you're feeling a little adventurous![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Tab 4 - Gamepad[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/49c584a855b6e99244c003a112ef52a3da140cb5.png"][/img][/h2][p]In this tab, you can enable or disable the use of a Gamepad in Harbinger - Legacy Edition.[/p][p]You can also change the sensitivity of the right stick.[/p][p]Due to the archaic nature of gamepad support, I generally recommend using Steam Input instead.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for this update! Thank you guys so much once again! and I'll continue to look closely at any reports or requests for Harbinger![/p][p][/p][p]Side note, I'd like to say that I lost access to my support email for about a week, and I apologize to everyone who contacted me there and didn't get a response. I'll be taking some extra time here to respond to everyone. This most definitely won't be happening again.[/p]

notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
[p]Hello! I'd like to start this post off by saying ; Thank you so much for the support![/p][p]While the wishlists/sales may be lackluster to some, however, to me, the over 200 of you showing interest in my silly FPS means a lot.[/p][p]I know I have quite a lot to prove to you, considering this is my first game on the platform. 
But I hope in the coming weeks/months/whichever shows my passion for this project, and how excited I am to share more with you all once I get into the position to do so.[/p][p]At the moment, though I will be completely transparent in the fact that I could use a small pause to plan the next updates based on what I personally feel Harbinger is really lacking in.[/p][p]Once I've got it all planned out, I'll post some more news about the next update![/p][p]So please bare with me while I take that time to do so, it would really mean a lot![/p][p][/p][p]With that being said, I once again thank you all, and I really hope that if you decide to take the dive, and to those that already have, Harbinger - Legacy Edition fulfills your expectations and even more so, being a fun, retro-esque Action-Horror FPS![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: THEY'RE HERE.
notes.content: [p]I'm so excited to announce that HARBINGER - Legacy Edition is now available!![/p][p]I've been working so hard on making sure the game is as polished as can be for the release,[/p][p]and I'm just so super hyped to see everyone's reactions and impressions when they get their hands on it![/p][p][/p][p]Please know that I highly recommend checking out the manual, kind of like when you were getting your hands on a game for the original Xbox or PlayStation 2![/p][p]There's a bunch of important information that I couldn't feasibly cram into the game itself.[/p][p][/p][p]I'd also like to say that I absolutely will be looking at player feedback, and plan to help make [/p][p]HARBINGER - Legacy Edition the absolute best it can be within the constraints of its engine.[/p][p]I do plan to optimize things more down the road as well, such as a more proper settings menu. [/p][p]Given the circumstances this is...a bit tricky, but I'm willing to bash my head against a brick wall (metaphorically) for this.[/p][p]I'm not one for false promises though, so I can't give anyone a set time on that.[/p][p][/p][p]On a brighter note, If you plan to experience everything HARBINGER has to offer,[/p][p]I'd recommend playing it in this order![/p][p]Main Story ---> Instant Action ---> The Extraction[/p][p][/p][p]That way you can get a more robust feel of the different mechanics the game has to offer, especially since The Extraction blends both Instant Action and Main Story together.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you all have a blast, FIGHT FOR HUMANITY![/p]

notes.title: All Hope Will Perish. 9-15-2025
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I've got some pretty HUGE news![/p][p]After over a year of working on Legacy Edition, and Harbinger as a whole for 5...[/p][p]I've found myself here, and we're ready to go![/p][p]On September 15th, Harbinger - Legacy Edition will be released with all announced content![/p][p]Check out the mini trailer here to get excited like I am :[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BauHqod1pyU"][/dynamiclink]On a side note, I've figured the best price possible for Harbinger - Legacy Edition would be $8 USD.[/p][p]With the potential of going free on event days[/p][p](More on that another time! I don't have the details squared away just yet, but I want to make it more than just a simple grab and go!)[/p][p]With that all being said, I'm so, so deeply proud and excited to share this with everyone, and I'm even more excited to see people playing the game I've put years of passion into.[/p][p]I hope everyone will be able to see the effort and love I've put into this project, as it's really not just a game to me, it's something more, a love letter, a mountain moved![/p][p]And more importantly? Fun and creepy as hell.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding post launch support;[/p][p]I am working on a website to post some news to and other fun goodies, as well as a support page so you can report bugs or other issues to me there. This will NOT replace posts on Steam![/p][p]I'd also like to state that I'd definitely like to take a few steps back to work on some more...lighthearted projects, but any issues that's slipped through the cracks or overall community recommendations will take the forefront for me, too. [/p][p]I want Harbinger - Legacy Edition to be the absolute best it can be under all circumstances.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone! and I hope to see you all there on release day.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Single Dose Demo & Development Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I'd like to share with you some new updates to Harbinger - Legacy Edition's Demo, and even the main game![/p][p]First of all, here's the changelog;[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Increased Bot View Cone from 30 to 50[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced numerous changes to bot code which improves their reactiveness and aggression to the player and other bots.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]It's a small one, but the changes should be pretty noticeable off the bat.[/p][p]As per usual, these changes will be present in the full game upon release![/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of the full game, I've got some news.[/p][p]I've got a set release date that I'm very confident in, and I plan to announce it very soon![/p][p][/p][p]Until then, here's a new peak at The Extraction, which will be included in the full game :[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/5Cf1O3f5NV0?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As always, I'm really happy to see the feedback from everyone, and I really look forward to seeing everyone's thoughts once the game finally releases, stay tuned for the upcoming release date announcement!!![/p]

notes.title: Harbinger - Legacy Edition "Single Dose" Demo Update Released
notes.content: [p]Welcome, agents! I've got some news for ya.[/p][p]Recently, the B.T.P.A. and I have been working on putting out a new update to improve the multiplayer of the Single Dose demo. (These will also be present in the main game upon release)[/p][p]Well if you're curious, you can check out the changes here:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Updated Multiplayer engine from BIM MP 2.3 to BIM MP 2.4[/p][p](This includes a plethora of improvements, such as a long standing engine issue where weapons would be deemed unusable after awhile of play.)[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother, faster movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased some file sizes, which should improve the playability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new map playable in Multiplayer "DM_WeaponsTest"[/p][/*][*][p]Changed launcher font[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all for now, we'll be keeping an eye on yalls feedback and thoughts![/p][p]Hope you enjoy the new changes![/p]

notes.title: "Single Dose" Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everybody! 
After a little while of waiting for Steam, and my own foolishness...[/p][p]the Single Dose Demo is available now!

This demo includes...[/p][p][/p][p]-2 Single Player Levels[/p][p]-2 Instant Action Levels[/p][p]-1 Multiplayer Level![/p][p][/p][p]The Manual for the main game applies to the demo, so if you have any problems[/p][p]getting things set up, PLEASE refer to the manual!

If you're having any further issues, you can also contact me in my support email.[/p][p](Which is located on the manual) Thanks so much everybody! And...[/p][p][/p][p]Just try to make it out alive...Alright?[/p]

notes.title: HARBINGER LE News - Demo Soon!
notes.content: [p]Hey all! Small little update here.[/p][p]But I'd like to say that I've started work on a demo for Harbinger a few days ago, and assuming all goes well,[/p][p]It should be out in the next few days![/p][p][/p][p]I want to give you guys a good taste of what's to come with the game, so I'll give you a little synopsis of the level of content I plan to release with the demo :[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]2 Main Story Levels[/p][/*][*][p]2 Instant Action Levels[/p][/*][*][p]1 Online Arena level[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The Main Story levels are missions that aren't normally connected, and are altered a bit. But they should give a great idea for what to expect in the main story, I've also included one Team-Deathmatch map for Instant action, and one Deathmatch map![/p][p]As for the multiplayer map, it will be on Team Deathmatch.[/p][p][/p][p]I will let you guys know if anything changes, but like I said, it should be coming within the next few days. Thank you so much everyone![/p]

notes.title: Announcing HARBINGER - LEGACY EDITION!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the Harbinger Legacy Edition...[/p][p]I've got some BIG news for you. [/p][p]There's been some huge changes to Harbinger, lately.[/p][p]Most notably : The crashing and instability. It is GONE. (Almost entirely, it's very, very rare now!)[/p][p]Thanks to some extra optimization work and the fine people at BIMA,[/p][p]I've been able to bring the final, true overhaul to this version of Harbinger.[/p][p]This includes, and is not limited to :[/p][p]Multiplayer Arena.[/p][p]This new revamped Multiplayer Arena mode features 8 new maps, and 3 game modes.[/p][p]Taking place shortly after the campaign, the war on bio-terror has begun. [/p][p]Fight against the terror as the BTPA, or relish in the torment as the Vonamoore Cultists.[/p][p]Each map supports up to 6 players either LAN or Online. A manual is included in the Multiplayer for steps on hosting/joining and other lore/locale information.[/p][p][/p][p]***Please note, the multiplayer uses very proprietary and outdated software. The service is provided as-is with no guarantees whatsoever. It's highly experimental.[/p][p]Instant Action does not use or require an internet connection and provides the same Arena experience locally with Bots***[/p][p][/p][p]Instant Action[/p][p]Don't want to deal with online? No problem. Select Instant Action, and choose any of the multiplayer maps and modes and play locally with Bots. [/p][p]Fight on either side, give commands to your ai teammates, and eliminate all opposition.[/p][p]***There are no online features for this mode, some multiplayer maps have been lightly altered for playability.***[/p][p][/p][p]New Expansion Story "The Extraction"[/p][p]Play through three new action packed chapters as a special agent for the Bio-Terrorism Prevention Agency (B.T.P.A.).[/p][p]HQ has gathered intel on the existence of a new parasitic organism that has evolved due to the Vaccine testing in a Vonamoore facility operated by the cultists, based on the information gathered by HQ, it seems the parasite has both the capability of causing great harm, and helping millions. The parasite, due to its unconventional evolution, releases a chemical that can heal even horrific wounds quickly, and without side effects. It is absolutely imperative that you capture this creature, and bring it home for further research. Take in mind, this organism is still largely a weapon.[/p][p]Expect heavy opposition.[/p][p][/p][p]And much, much more I'm so excited to share with you all in due time![url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/c4d3be16e9d426889e01753e2563e740c5f577a2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657054/2f979ccc2d492af4889b27bd2eab49c03d8f3fdc.png"][/img][/url][/p]
